authoring.palette: First two RGB colors are the frame colors, remaining 254 colors black.

originalCarrierRepresentationMeaning: Independent compact JSON kind,mimeType,data,width,height for ORIGINAL GIF carrier, explicitly NOT a predicted Native prepared representation.
independentValidation: Pillow reopens/loads both frames and verifies all RGB pixels, geometry, duration, disposal and frame count. hashlib pins original, both decoded RGB buffers and original-carrier compact JSON. No Bun.Image/OMP/SDK/native converter imported or evaluated.

expectedNativePreparation.preparedBytesAndSha256: UNPREDICTED converter-specific PNG/JPEG bytes/count/hash. Runtime checks canonical public representation digest consistency, changed carrier, indexed saved part and controlled provider delivery.
expectedNativePreparation.basis: prepareImage counts original GIF frames; animated or GIF input is converted through Bun.Image(...).png() then resizeImage(excludeWebP:true). It always declares image_transformed for GIF and animation_first_frame_only for two frames. 200x200 dimensions are within resize floor/caps. Model input declares text/image.
expectedNativePreparation.limits: Original frame pixels are independently pinned. Prepared output pixels, first-frame fidelity and prepared frame count are NOT independently decoded/evaluated. animation_first_frame_only is the Native declared contract; do not infer fidelity from this declaration or carrier hash.
